generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The call to `.dimension(fieldType().isDimension())` is redundant. The `dimension` parameter is already initialized with a lambda (`m -> toType(m).fieldType().isDimension()`) in the `Builder` constructor, and since it is included in the list returned by `getParameters()` (see #N8PRC), the subsequent call to `.init(this)` will automatically set its value using that initializer.

review_comment: I'd write 't' for true, 'f' for false. This is in line with https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/9c603a38f089d98bad47c365819d51d15f854e4c/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/index/mapper/XContentDataHelper.java#L354
